displayName: Don’t show redirect warnings for Autodiscover for the specified HTTPS server names (User)
description:
This policy setting allows you to specify HTTPS server names for which Autodiscover won’t show a warning message when redirecting from HTTP to HTTPS.

By default, when an Autodiscover operation redirects from HTTP to HTTPS, you may be shown a warning message about the redirection.

If you enable this policy setting, you need to specify HTTPS server names, and for those server names, you won’t be shown a warning message. For example, if you enter contoso.com, you won’t be shown a warning message when Autodiscover redirects to https://contoso.com.

If you disable or don’t configure this policy setting, you may be shown a warning message when an Autodiscover operation redirects from HTTP to HTTPS.
